profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Adobe
profile.summary:
Development Tools – Pycharm, Visual Studio, IntelliJ, Postman

Platforms – AWS, Apache Pulsar, SQL Server, Oracle, and SalesForce

Programming Languages – .NET C#, Python, SQL, T-SQL, PL/SQL

Project Management Tools – Atlassian Suite, Jira, and Confluence

positions.title: Staff Cloud Architect
positions.description:
Lead team of engineers in building a self-service Data Platform utilizing Confluent Platform (Kafka) and Databricks
Architected, designed, and built self-hosted Confluent Platform deployed on AWS utilizing EKS (Kubernetes)
Mentored junior engineers on building ELT Pipelines utilizing PySpark on Databricks
Mentored junior engineers on CI/CD best practices utilizing Azure Devops Pipelines

positions.title: Staff Data Engineer
positions.description:
Data Engineering
•	Lead team of engineers in building real-time data ingestion pipelines utilizing AWS and Apache Pulsar
•	Architected, designed, and built processes to reduce the length of time of onboarding from weeks/months to minutes
•	Architected, designed, and built solutions to automate Fraud and Compliance checks
•	Architected, designed, and built solutions to automate customer underwriting
•	Pioneered efforts to utilize strong OOP principles in python to facilitate the team to start writing “code” instead of scripts

positions.title: Lead Data Engineer
positions.description:
Data Engineering
• Lead team of engineers building real-time event driven architecture solutions
• Architected, designed, and built a data pipeline ingesting over 1 million events per hour with a consistent < 200ms latency
• Utilized AWS Serverless technology to build Apollo Federation GraphQL layer to expose analytical data from the warehouse
• Utilized Ralph Kimball modeling methodologies to design the data warehouse

positions.title: Big Data Manager
positions.description:
Data Engineering
•	Responsible for the design, architecture, and implementation of our serverless AWS cloud based big data pipeline.
•	Utilize Apache Kafka in conjunction with Apache NiFi to ingest events from millions of IOT devices every day
•	Lead team of engineers on best practices for big data processing/automation
•	Utilize AWS serverless technologies for cost efficient data processing. AWS Lambda, S3, Glue, Athena, Kinesis, etc.
•	Display expert level knowledge with AWS Cloud Architecture and distributed processing.

positions.title: Big Data Architect
positions.description:
Data Warehousing:
• Architect a cloud based data ingestion platform utilizing .Net Core, AWS S3, AWS Kinesis Firehose, and AWS Redshift
• Utilize Ralph Kimball modeling methodologies to design star and snowflake schemas
• Lead data mart architecture by coaching a team on raw data extracts and transformation insights that are within the data

positions.title: Data Architect
positions.description:
Data Warehousing:
• Develop ETL processes to move data from OLTP systems into a data warehouse by authoring a custom .NET application
• Build over 50 .NET, T-SQL, PL/SQL, and SSIS ETL processes for enterprise data warehouse and reporting systems

Transactional Systems:
• Architect new Point of Sale database which interfaces with new UX and UI layers for over 1,400 store locations
• Produce accounting reports, using complex SQL queries, to rectify over one million dollar discrepancies on the general ledger

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Streamlined ETL processes from a variety of data sources into the platform’s single database to increase ease of use.
• Lead development for all ETL processes, VB.Net, C#, and SQL stored procedures to ensure source code was optimized.
• Debugged all database process, SOAP web services, rest web services, reports, and customer production issues.
